license_required.quote: No nursing home in the state may operate unless it is under the management of a nursing home administrator who holds a currently valid license, provisional license, or temporary license.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Nursing Home Administrators.

name.quote: "Board" means the Board of Nursing Home Administrators.

type.quote: The Board of Nursing Home Administrators is created within the department and shall consist of seven members

moral_character_required.quote: These standards shall be designed to ensure that nursing home administrators are individuals of good character and otherwise suitable and, by training or experience in the field of institutional administration, qualified to serve as nursing home administrators.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university
degree_required.quote: Holds a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and majored in health care administration, health services administration, or an equivalent major, or has credit for at least 60 semester hours in subjects, as prescribed by rule of the board

degree_level.quote: Holds a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university

school_approval_basis.quote: Holds a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university

credential_pegged.quote: Holds a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and majored in health care administration, health services administration, or an equivalent major

required.quote: Has fulfilled the requirements of a college-affiliated or university-affiliated internship in nursing home administration or of a 1,000-hour nursing home administrator-in-training program prescribed by the board

experience_source.quote: Has fulfilled the requirements of a college-affiliated or university-affiliated internship in nursing home administration or of a 1,000-hour nursing home administrator-in-training program prescribed by the board

duration.value: 1,000 hours (Track A) or 2,000 hours (Track B) administrator-in-training program, or 1 year management experience (Track B alternative)
duration.quote: Has fulfilled the requirements of a 2,000-hour nursing home administrator-in-training program prescribed by the board; or Has 1 year of management experience allowing for the application of executive duties and skills

kind.value: nursing home administrator-in-training program or management experience in skilled nursing facility
kind.quote: Has fulfilled the requirements of a college-affiliated or university-affiliated internship in nursing home administration or of a 1,000-hour nursing home administrator-in-training program prescribed by the board

exams.name: Nursing Home Administrator Licensure Examination
exams.notes: The board may adopt use of a national examination in lieu of part or all of the state examination. Examination fee not to exceed $250.
exams.jurisdiction: state (with option for national examination by board rule)
exams.quote: Any person desiring to be licensed as a nursing home administrator shall apply to the department to take the licensure examination. The examination shall be given at least two times a year

exams.name: Laws and Rules Examination
exams.notes: Required for temporary license applicants; must be taken and passed after issuance of temporary license.
exams.quote: The applicant must take and pass the next laws and rules examination offered in this state following issuance of a temporary license.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: The board may by rule prescribe continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

hours_per_period.quote: The board may by rule prescribe continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

period_years.quote: The board may by rule prescribe continuing education, not to exceed 40 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

available.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to any applicant who, upon applying to the department and remitting a fee set by the board not to exceed $500, demonstrates to the board that he or she meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145.

requirements.value: Must meet requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145; fee not to exceed $500; must have worked as a fully licensed nursing home administrator for 2 years within the 5-year period immediately preceding application for temporary license (if applying for temporary license).
requirements.quote: demonstrates to the board that he or she meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

exists.quote: The Board of Nursing Home Administrators is created within the department and shall consist of seven members

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall: Practice nursing home administration unless the person holds an active license to practice nursing home administration.

credential_type.quote: No nursing home in the state may operate unless it is under the management of a nursing home administrator who holds a currently valid license, provisional license, or temporary license.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall: Practice nursing home administration unless the person holds an active license to practice nursing home administration.

title_protection.quote: Use the name or title "nursing home administrator" when the person has not been licensed pursuant to this act.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall: Practice nursing home administration unless the person holds an active license to practice nursing home administration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of s. 456.072(1) or s. 468.1745(1)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of s. 456.072(1) or s. 468.1745(1).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through error of the department or board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure a license to practice nursing home administration by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice nursing home administration revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime relating to nursing home administration or the ability to practice it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, of a crime in any jurisdiction which relates to the practice of nursing home administration or the ability to practice nursing home administration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or failing to file required reports, or obstructing such filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing the discharge or transfer of a resident for reasons other than those provided in the statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing the discharge or transfer of a resident for a reason other than those provided in ss. 400.022 and 400.0255.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of nursing home administration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit, negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of nursing home administration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a lawful board or department order or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly acting in a manner inconsistent with the health, safety, or welfare of the patients of the facility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly acting in a manner inconsistent with the health, safety, or welfare of the patients of the facility in which he or she is the administrator.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice nursing home administration with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice nursing home administration with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, drunkenness, use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other material or substance or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violating any provisions of law, code, or rules of licensing or supervising authorities having jurisdiction over nursing homes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or repeatedly violating any of the provisions of the law, code, or rules of the licensing or supervising authority or agency of the state or political subdivision thereof having jurisdiction of the operation and licensing of nursing homes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or offering to pay a commission or valuable consideration for solicitation or procurement of nursing home usage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying, giving, causing to be paid or given, or offering to pay or to give to any person a commission or other valuable consideration for the solicitation or procurement, either directly or indirectly, of nursing home usage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully permitting unauthorized disclosure of information relating to a patient or patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully permitting unauthorized disclosure of information relating to a patient or his or her records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discriminating with respect to patients, employees, or staff on account of race, religion, color, sex, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discriminating with respect to patients, employees, or staff on account of race, religion, color, sex, or national origin.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to implement an ongoing quality assurance program directed by an interdisciplinary team meeting at least every other month
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to implement an ongoing quality assurance program directed by an interdisciplinary team that meets at least every other month.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of chapter 468 or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: Practice of nursing home administration means any service requiring nursing home administration education, training, or experience and the application of such to the planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling of the total management of a nursing home.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing home administration" means any service requiring nursing home administration education, training, or experience and the application of such to the planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling of the total management of a nursing home.

value: controlling of total management of a nursing home
methods_authorized.quote: the application of such to the planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling of the total management of a nursing home

provisional_license_available.quote: A provisional license shall be issued only to fill a position of nursing home administrator that unexpectedly becomes vacant due to illness, sudden death of the administrator, or abandonment of position and shall be issued for one single period as provided by rule not to exceed 6 months.

temporary_permit_available.quote: A temporary license may be issued one time only to an applicant who has filed an application for licensure by endorsement

temporary_permit_facility_restricted.quote: A temporary license shall be valid for the nursing home administrator applicant only at the facility for which it is issued and shall not be transferred to another facility or to another applicant.

facility_type_covered.quote: "Nursing home" means an institution or facility licensed as such under part II of chapter 400.

experience_substitutable_for_education.quote: Has 1 year of management experience allowing for the application of executive duties and skills, including the staffing, budgeting, and directing of resident care, dietary, and bookkeeping departments within a skilled nursing facility, hospital, hospice, assisted living facility with a minimum of 60 licensed beds, or geriatric residential treatment program

board_composition_required.value: Seven members: three licensed nursing home administrators, two health care practitioners, two laypersons (not and never nursing home administrators or health care professionals); at least one member must be 60 years of age or older.
board_composition_required.quote: Three members of the board must be licensed nursing home administrators. Two members of the board must be health care practitioners. The remaining two members of the board must be laypersons who are not, and have never been, nursing home administrators or members of any health care profession or occupation. At least one member of the board must be 60 years of age or older.

board_member_term_years.quote: to be appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Senate to a term of 4 years or for a term to complete an unexpired vacancy.

interdepartmental_deficiency_reporting_r.quote: Set up procedures by rule for advising and acting together with the Department of Health and other boards of other health professions in matters affecting procedures and methods for effectively enforcing the purpose of this part and the administration of chapters 400 and 429.
